entities.name: Emergency number list
entities.description: An information element that contains a list of emergency numbers valid within the same country as the PLMN from which it is received.

entities.name: Network
entities.description: The network entity that may send the emergency number list information element to the UE.

entities.name: PLMN
entities.description: Public Land Mobile Network from which the emergency number list IE is received, determining the country context for the emergency numbers.

relations.description: The network may send the emergency number list information element to the UE.
The emergency number list contents are valid within the same country as the PLMN from which the IE is received.
